title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
brief: Carry out compatible PostgreSQL schema and index changes with bounded waits and complete acceptance.
outcomes: Choose native operations from their lock and rewrite behaviour
Validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes safely
entry: General schema-change protocol, PostgreSQL indexes and locking.

heading.title: Locks and rewrites
heading.brief: Inspect the lock and scan or rewrite requirements of a proposed change; use lock and statement timeouts without assuming cancellation instantly removes every cost.

heading.title: Compatible data migration
heading.brief: Apply the shared money-representation migration with old and new callers; implement captured writes, bounded batches and final discrepancy checks.

heading.title: Index lifecycle
heading.brief: Build, validate, rebuild and remove indexes using appropriate native operations; inspect failed concurrent-build state and the evidence for sparse or unused indexes.

heading.title: Contracting the schema
heading.brief: Prove new reads and writes complete before dropping the old representation; record dependencies, rollback boundary and production acceptance signals.

nested_article.title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
nested_article.brief: Choose and rehearse a PostgreSQL upgrade or migration with a recoverable write handover.
outcomes: Distinguish in-place major upgrade from logical migration
Validate compatibility, cutover and the point of no easy return
nested_article.entry: Backups, logical replication, schema compatibility and authority fencing.
